name: Cowpool
summary:
If you could change one rule in pool, would it be:

1. Nothing

2. The table now contains grazing cattle?

Cowpool is a puzzle game hidden underneath a simple concept. The statespace of the board is tracked during gameplay - and its up to you to learn how to traverse it.

Or you can just sit back and knock some balls around, make up your own rules or play regular pool but with cows. Youre an infinite mind, you make each new day, theres nothing more I can say!
